source_field_map.peg_theoretical_price: theoretical_price (PPS, frxUSD per share) x the same run's frxUSD/USD market_price (frxUSD to 2026-09-15, frxUSD_Ethereum from 2026-09-16)

coverage_gaps_basis: consecutive daily points more than 3 days apart; no prices were observed inside a gap and none are interpolated

entries.reference_missing_reason: no frxUSD mark written in the same tracker run

legacy_mixed_unit_field.basis: the tracker's stored peg_deviation: USD market vs frxUSD-denominated PPS, i.e. an implicit $1-per-frxUSD convention; kept for audit, NOT the series

coverage.market_source_clock_basis: rows before first_row_with_market_source_clock record only the tracker write time, not CoinGecko's own last_updated_at
coverage.basis: no data exists before the central series' first sfrxUSD row; none is fabricated

observations_basis: every central row in the trailing 7 days, not downsampled; each carries its own PPS and frxUSD mark
